div.div:
Stricter option: network isolated cluster
outbound type none (or block, preview) and bootstrap artifact source Cache:
AKS pulls its own images and binaries from a private ACR cache, so creating, scaling and upgrading the cluster needs no egress.
Add egress back only for what your workloads actually call.
